posts.title: Power Factor
posts.description: While I’d certainly contest the “Atari Lynx classic” label given by Evercade, Power Factor is an interesting game and I think it’s actually a good inclusion for a collection. It showcases a lot about the Lynx, both good and bad, and I think there’s value in examining something that puts it all together for you to see and experience so clearly. posts.title: Flying Hamster HD
posts.description: I feel like this post has come off perhaps a bit harder than I’d like, but I think that’s because Flying Hamster is so, so close to greatness. I love everything about its presentation, the music is great, and the way they incorporate weapons into the environments in natural ways is one of the most interesting choices I’ve seen in the genre in a long time. posts.title: Ephemeral Enigmas Presents: Uniquely Unappreciated Underdogs in the 2026 Video Game Storybundle
posts.description: Uniquely Unappreciated Underdogs is very much in the same vein as what you see on this blog every week in that I talk about 15 different games that I think deserve a more thorough and fair look at what they do best. Some of the games included will be familiar to longtime readers, but I've also included several games that I've never spoken about at length before, so there's plenty new here for you
